names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 21 февраля ст. ст., which gives the calendar's own nominative «Даниил (Алферов), иерей, сщмч.»; the rank word and the office are left off. The line on the day page itself gives only the forename, in the genitive, and no surname; the surname in brackets comes from the name link and is kept.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru for 21 февраля ст. ст.: «Сщмчч. Александра, Даниила и Григория пресвитеров (1930).». The calendar gives no other year and no life page.
